method: Direct Japanese-source authoring for both locales and full own-source semantic self-review of every string. No other-pair reading, cross-review, external translation service or summary substitution.
coverage: Every lesson/cluster title, full explanatory/example paragraph, application prompt, key term and illustration alt text from collectTranslatableUnits.
semanticChecks: Morning-meeting attendance does not complete task-specific preparation; change information, worker experience and pre-use inspection retain own scope.
Safety cycle spans start to finish; later condition changes require their own confirmation.
Finding/instructing differs from actual improvement; inspection count does not prove completion.
Separate schedules do not establish common agreement; time/place and post-work public/fire/opening/material conditions retain source scope.
Hiring/task-change education is not replaced by experience, operating instructions or class duration.
Machine/material hazards, health effects, protection, inspection, disease prevention and withdrawal retain distinct content.
New-site induction differs from hiring education and past-site passes; inter-trade coordination, command, evacuation and communication are site-specific.
Upstream contractor role retains Japanese statutory term 元方事业者/元方事業者 rather than substituting commissioning client.
Distributing documents does not prove recipient understanding.
Helmet, footwear and full-body harness roles remain distinct; markings/purchase records do not establish current undamaged condition.
No height threshold, transition deadline, legal exemption or universal equipment selection rule invented.
Eyewear impact/heat/harmful-light and clear face shield/welding shading protections remain separate.
Dust filtering does not establish oxygen supply; no mask is presented as oxygen-deficiency protection.
Glove material/task and rotating-machine entanglement limits remain; no universal glove-use rule added.
Heat risk not determined solely by forecast air temperature; local/time-specific heat assessment, rest availability and work plans remain separate.
Suspected abnormal health response is referred through source-specified site reporting; endurance is not approval to continue.
Green-cross sign does not substitute first-aid-kit content/location and emergency contacts; no medical treatment procedure added.
